$comment: ARV-096a (wiki 13 section 9): a dependency or image finding allowed to stay open past its remediation frame. Each entry: finding (a GHSA or CVE id), package, reason, compensatingControl, proposedBy, approvedBy (the owner, never the proposer and never an agent; PENDING until then), approvedOn (YYYY-MM-DD, set with approvedBy) and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days after approvedOn). An expired entry, or one whose approvedBy is PENDING, excuses nothing and fails the step itself once the frames are approved. A malformed approval (approvedBy not the owner, or the same as proposedBy; approvedOn missing, not a real day or in the future, expires before approvedOn or more than 90 days after it) fails it at once, and so does an approved entry that a reference (HEAD, and the newest of main and origin/main that is an ancestor of HEAD) does not hold unchanged in every field, a reference without this file counting as an empty list; an approval committed on a reference itself is left to review and the proposed hook (docs/product/decisions.md).
